data.title: Shipping service rollout stuck – 0 ready replicas

data.query: service=shipping category=bad_deploy alert: Shipping rollout stuck – 0/3 pods ready

data.summary: Prior bad deploy pattern (orders, 2026-09-26): revision introduced broken image → nil pointer dereference → HTTP 500 on checkout. Resolution: kubectl rollout undo. Approved postmortem on record.

data.root_cause: Deployment revision 8 specified a non-existent image tag (rlvr/shipping:v99-nonexistent). All new pods are stuck in ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull because the registry returns 'manifest unknown'. The rollout exceeded progressDeadlineSeconds and is permanently wedged (ProgressDeadlineExceeded). Prior pattern from orders service (inc-003) confirms this is a bad_deploy category — rollback resolves.
